DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: アパートの共同玄関が閉まりません。修理をこちらへ頼むのか、管理会社へ伝えるのか分からず、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同玄関が閉まらず警察修理か管理会社か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shared entrance to my apartment building won't close. I don't know whether to ask you for repairs or inform the management company, so I'd like some advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the shared entrance won't close and ask whether the police or management company should handle repairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、誰かが無理に入ろうとしているなど、見ている状況はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you seeing anything happening now, such as someone trying to force their way in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そのような人は見ていません。今朝ドアが開いたままだと気付きました。原因や、いつからかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝気付き侵入者は未目撃で原因開始時刻も不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't seen anyone like that. I noticed this morning that the door was open. I don't know the cause or when it started.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noticed it this morning, saw no intruder, and do not know the cause or starting time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 設備の修理は管理する方へご相談ください。危険な状況がある場合は、その時の状況を知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consult whoever manages the property about equipment repairs. If there is a dangerous situation, tell us what is happening at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず管理会社へ、玄関が閉まらない状態を伝えます。知らない人を見たわけではないので、侵入した人がいると加えて話しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理会社へ不具合を伝え目撃していない侵入を話へ加えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll first tell the management company that the entrance won't close. I haven't seen any stranger, so I won't add a claim that someone broke in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will report the fault to management and not add an intrusion you did not witness.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住人の通行を妨げるような物を置かず、管理する方へ状態をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't place anything that would obstruct residents' passage; please have the property manager check the condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の自転車で入口をふさぐのはやめます。ドアへ道具を使う前に、管理会社の対応を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自転車で入口をふさがず道具で触る前に管理対応を待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't block the entrance with my bicycle. I'll wait for the management company's response before using tools on the door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't block the entrance with a bicycle and will wait for management before using tools on the door.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理会社の連絡先は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you know how to contact the management company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 契約の案内にあります。そこへ見た時刻と閉まらない状態を伝え、現在誰かが入ろうとしているかとは分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 契約案内の管理連絡先へ時刻状態を伝え現在危険とは区別すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's in the information with my lease. I'll tell them when I saw it and that it won't close, separately from whether anyone is currently trying to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will use the management contact in the lease guide to report the time and condition, distinguishing it from current danger.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 設備の不具合は管理する方へお知らせください。新たな危険があれば状況を分けてご連絡ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please notify the property manager about equipment faults. If a new danger arises, contact us with that situation described separately. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送の準備で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with preparing your shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 伝票の届け先の欄へ、自分の名前を書き始めてしまいました。まだ貼っていないので、直してから送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届け先欄へ自分名を書き始め未貼付なので修正したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I started writing my own name in the recipient field on the shipping label. I haven't attached it yet, so I'd like to correct it before sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you began writing your own name as the recipient, haven't attached the label, and want to correct it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所まで書きましたか。受取人の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you write the address too? Do you have the recipient's information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の名前だけです。受取人の住所はこのメモにあります。自分の家へ送るのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人名だけで受取住所メモあり本人宅へ送らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only my own name. The recipient's address is on this note. I'm not sending it to my own home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you wrote only your name, have the recipient address on a note, and aren't shipping to your own home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい伝票で、届け先と差出人を分けてご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use a new label and enter the recipient and sender separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 届け先は友人、差出人は私ですね。前の伝票を横に置いて写すのでなく、住所メモから友人の欄を先に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届け先友人差出人本人として旧票を写さず住所メモから書くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient is my friend and the sender is me, correct? Rather than copying from the old label beside me, I'll fill in my friend's section first from the address note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that your friend is the recipient and you the sender, and you will use the address note rather than copy the old label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お電話番号の欄も、それぞれの情報をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the information for each phone-number field as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の番号を両方へ書かず、友人の番号が必要なら本人に確認します。分からない欄は推測して埋めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二欄へ本人番号を書かず必要友人番号は本人へ聞き不明欄推測しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't put my number in both. If my friend's number is needed, I'll ask them. I won't guess to fill in unknown fields.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't put your number in both fields, will ask your friend for theirs if needed, and won't guess unknown entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完成したら、誤って書いた伝票と混ぜずにお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once complete, show it to us without mixing it with the incorrect label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正しい届け先と自分の差出人欄を確認します。書きかけの方は使わず、新しい一枚だけを貼る前に見ていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書きかけを使わず新票一枚だけ貼付前に確認してもらうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the correct recipient and my own sender section. I won't use the unfinished label; I'll show you only the new one before attaching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't use the partly completed label and will have only the new label checked before attaching it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未使用の新しい伝票で確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check using a fresh, unused label. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 残高を見て今月使えるお金を考えています。ただ、まだ支払っていない家賃があります。残高にもう反映されたか、取引の見方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高を予算と考えるが家賃未払い見込みで実取引の見方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking at my balance to work out what I can spend this month. But I have rent I haven't paid yet. I'd like to ask how to read the transactions to see whether it is already reflected in the balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you're considering the balance as a budget but expect unpaid rent, and ask how to read actual transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お支払いの予定と、実際の取引記録を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish scheduled payments from actual transaction records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家賃は来週の予定です。自分の家計メモには書きましたが、口座から引かれたかは明細で確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来週支払予定を家計メモへ書いたが明細未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The rent is scheduled for next week. I've written it in my household budget note, but haven't checked the statement to see whether it was debited.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that next week's scheduled payment is in your budget note but you haven't checked the statement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録に支払いが載っているか、ご本人の取引を担当と確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check your own transactions with the staff member to see whether the payment appears in the records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家計メモへ書いたことと、実際に支払ったことを同じにせず、日付と内容を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メモ記入と実支払いを区別し記録日付内容を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. I want to look at the date and details, without treating writing it in my budget note as the same as actually paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to distinguish a budget-note entry from actual payment and check the recorded date and details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今後の予定は口座の表示だけでは分からない場合があります。支払先との約束もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The account display alone may not show future plans. Please also check your arrangement with the payee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の予定は自分のメモに残します。残高があるから全部使えると考えず、未払い分を別に管理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定は自分で残し残高全額を自由額とみなさず未払いを別管理すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep next week's plan in my own note. I won't assume the whole balance is available to spend; I'll manage the unpaid amount separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will keep your own schedule and manage unpaid amounts separately rather than treat the whole balance as disposable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認したい取引の期間を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the staff member which transaction period you want to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今月の家賃に当たる記録を確認したいと伝えます。未払いなら予定を残し、支払い済みなら日付をメモへ追記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家賃記録を確認し未払いなら予定維持支払済なら日付追記と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say I want to check the record for this month's rent. If unpaid, I'll keep it scheduled; if paid, I'll add the payment date to my note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the rent record, keep the schedule if unpaid, and add the date if paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予定と取引記録を分けるご相談ですね。担当とご確認ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're consulting about separating plans and transaction records. Please check with the staff member. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。食材選びのお手伝いをしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you choose ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: レシピにチーズ一袋とありますが、ここには大きさの違う袋があります。袋数だけで決めず、必要な量を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: レシピのチーズ一袋は商品袋サイズが違い必要量確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipe says one bag of cheese, but the bags here differ in size. Rather than deciding by the number of bags, I'd like to check the amount needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the recipe says one bag of cheese but product sizes differ, so you want to check the required amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシピには重さも書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the recipe also give a weight?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の所に百グラムとありました。いま手に取ったのは二百グラムなので、一袋全部だと多くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシピ百グラム手元二百で全部なら多いと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says 100 grams elsewhere. The one I've picked up is 200 grams, so using the whole bag would be too much.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the recipe calls for100 grams but yours is200, so the whole bag would be too much.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 百グラム入りの商品もこちらにあります。どちらを選ばれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have a100-gram product here too. Which would you choose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は一回だけ作るので、百グラムを一袋にします。二百グラムの方が得でも、残りを使う予定はまだありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一回分だけ作り残り用途未定なので百グラム一袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm making it only once today, so I'll take one100-gram bag. Even if200 grams is better value, I haven't planned how to use the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose one100-gram bag in Japanese because you're making it once and have no plan for the remainder.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 種類もレシピで指定されている物と見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please compare the type with the one specified in the recipe too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 細く切ったチーズの指定です。百グラムでも別の種類を取らず、料理用の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重さだけで別種類を選ばず細切り料理用表示を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It specifies shredded cheese. I won't pick a different type just because it's100 grams; I'll check the cooking-use label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you won't choose another type based only on weight and will check for shredded cheese intended for cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの包装の容量と種類をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the quantity and type on this packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容量百グラムと種類を見て一袋買います。レシピの一袋を、どの商品でも一袋という意味にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量種類を確認しレシピ袋数を全商品共通にしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check that it's100 grams and the correct type, then buy one bag. I won't interpret “one bag” in the recipe to mean one bag of any product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check quantity and type and won't apply the recipe's bag count to every product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 容量と種類を合わせてお選びください。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose by matching both quantity and type. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。清掃のお手伝いで何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have a question about helping with cleanup?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 落ちた紙を集めていますが、ベンチの飲物と新聞も捨てられた物か迷っています。持ち主の物を勝手に袋へ入れたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃中ベンチの新聞飲物がごみか不明で無断回収せず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm collecting fallen paper, but I'm unsure whether the drink and newspaper on the bench were discarded too. I don't want to put someone's belongings in the rubbish bag without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that during cleanup you aren't sure whether the newspaper and drink on the bench are rubbish, and won't collect them without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 近くに使っている方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there anyone using them nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 少し離れた人がベンチへ戻るように見えました。ただ、その人の物かはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 離れた人が戻るように見えたが所有者とは未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Someone a little way away looked as though they were returning to the bench. But I haven't asked whether the items are theirs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that someone farther away seemed to be returning, but ownership hasn't been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち主がいるか確認できない物は、そのまま担当へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: For items whose owner you can't establish, leave them as they are and inform the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。新聞が古そうに見えても、それだけでごみと判断しません。地面の紙片と別に扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古い新聞という見た目だけでごみとせず地面紙片と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't judge the newspaper as rubbish just because it looks old. I'll treat it separately from scraps on the ground.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't judge an old-looking newspaper as rubbish and will distinguish it from scraps on the ground.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 清掃で集めた物の場所も、担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Also tell the person in charge where you collected items during cleanup.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩道の紙片は拾いました。ベンチの物は触らず、位置と見た状態を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩道紙片は回収済みだがベンチ物は未接触で位置状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've picked up the scraps from the pavement. I haven't touched the items on the bench; I'll report their location and the condition I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that pavement scraps were collected, bench items weren't touched, and you will report their location and condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認するまで、そこにある物を動かさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't move those items until the person in charge checks them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 集めた紙片だけ袋へ入れます。ベンチの飲物と新聞は担当へ知らせ、持ち主の確認後の指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙片だけ袋へ入れベンチ物は担当へ知らせ所有確認指示を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put only the collected scraps in the bag. I'll report the drink and newspaper on the bench and wait for instructions after ownership is checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will bag only scraps, report the bench items, and await instructions after ownership confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 回収済みの紙と未確認の物を分けていただきありがとうございます。担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for separating collected paper from unconfirmed items. The person in charge will check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の電話が長くなって、発車の案内を聞き逃しました。電話を終えてから次の便を確認したいのですが、どの表示を見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長い仕事電話で発車案内を逃し通話終了後に便表示を確認したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: A work call ran long and I missed the departure announcement. I'd like to check the next service after ending the call; which display should I look at?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a long work call made you miss the departure announcement and you want to check the service display after ending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行きたい駅と、今いらっしゃる乗場を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me the station you want to reach and the platform you're on now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市街地の駅へ行きます。ここは一番乗場です。電話で話しながら来たので、乗場が合っているかも確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的駅と一番乗場を伝え通話中移動で乗場も未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm going to the station in the city center. This is platform1. I came while talking on the phone, so haven't checked whether this is the right platform either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the destination and platform1, and that you haven't checked the platform because you moved while calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの発車表示で行先と乗場を見比べられます。通話は壁側でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can compare the destination and platform on this departure display. Please make calls by the wall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず壁側へ寄って、仕事の相手へ移動中なので後でかけ直すと伝えます。電話の返事をしながら表示を読むのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 壁側へ寄り仕事相手へ後で折返すと伝えて表示確認に集中すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll first move toward the wall and tell the person from work that I'm traveling and will call back later. I'll stop reading the display while responding on the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will move by the wall, tell your work contact you'll call back, and concentrate on checking the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お話が終わりましたら、行先の表示を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've finished, let's check the destination display together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 終わりました。この行の行先と乗場を見たいです。今止まっている列車がその便か、車両の表示でも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通話終了後行先乗場と実車表示を見比べたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm finished. I'd like to look at this row's destination and platform. I'll also check the display on the train itself to see whether the train here is that service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after ending the call you want to compare the destination, platform, and actual train display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示が分からなければ、乗る前に係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you don't understand the display, ask a staff member before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行先と乗場を確認して乗ります。仕事の電話は、降りて落ち着いた場所からかけ直すと相手へ伝えてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後乗車し仕事電話は降車後落ち着いた所で折返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the destination and platform before boarding. I've told my work contact I'll call back after getting off, from somewhere I can settle down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will board after checking and return the work call from a quiet place after getting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通話を区切って確認できましたね。足元にお気を付けてお進みください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You were able to pause the call and check. Please watch your step as you proceed. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのような案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What information are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越してきたので、市の案内を持ち帰りたいです。棚に保存版と今月号があり、どちらを読めばよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入後の市案内で保存版と今月号の選び方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've just moved here and would like to take home city information. The shelf has a reference edition and this month's issue; please tell me which to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to choose between the city reference guide and this month's issue after moving here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 知りたいのは生活全般の案内ですか。それとも近いうちの催しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you want general information about daily life, or upcoming events?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 生活全般と、週末の催しです。一冊で両方分かると思っていましたが、載る内容が違うようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 生活全般と週末催しの両方を知りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both general living information and weekend events. I thought one booklet would cover both, but it seems their contents differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want both general living information and weekend events.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存版は全般の案内、月号はその時期のお知らせとしてご覧いただけます。個別の最新条件は担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The reference edition offers general guidance, and monthly issues carry notices for that period. Check specific current conditions with the relevant staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つを目的別に読みます。保存版に窓口を調べる目印を付け、今月号では催しの日付を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二種を目的別に読み保存版窓口と月号催し日付を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll read the two for different purposes. I'll mark the reference guide to find service counters, and check event dates in this month's issue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the two for different purposes, checking counters in the reference guide and event dates in the monthly issue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 月号は表紙の年月も確認してください。以前の号も棚にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the year and month on the monthly issue's cover. Older issues are on the shelf too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月号を選びます。古い号の募集を、今も申し込めるものと考えず、行きたい催しの担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表紙年月で現号を選び古い募集を受付中とみなさず担当確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose this month's issue. I won't assume applications advertised in an old issue are still open; I'll ask the staff responsible for the event I want to attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will select the current issue by its cover date and check with staff rather than assume old applications are open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な冊数をお持ちください。ご家族用も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Take the number of copies you need. Do you also need copies for your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ家で一緒に読むので、一冊ずつで大丈夫です。二つの表紙の年月を見てから持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族と共用で各一冊のみ年月確認後持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll read together at home, so one of each is enough. I'll check the year and month on both covers before taking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will share with family, taking only one of each after checking the dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 保存版と今月号を一冊ずつどうぞ。ご不明な案内は担当へお尋ねください。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take one reference guide and one current issue. Ask the relevant staff about any unclear information. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい文字を読む眼鏡を忘れました。用紙の欄が見えにくいので、分からないまま書かず、読む手伝いをお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読書用眼鏡を忘れ小字用紙の読支援を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot my glasses for reading small print. I can't see the fields on this form well, so rather than write without understanding, I'd like help reading it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for help reading the small-print form because you forgot your reading glasses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えにくいのは、どの部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part is difficult to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この注意書きです。大きい氏名欄は見えますが、その下の細い文章が読めません。全部の文字が見えないわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名大字は見えるが下の注意書きは見えぬ範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This cautionary note. I can see the large name field, but can't read the small text below. It's not that I can't see any of the writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the large name field is visible but the cautionary text below isn't, specifying the affected part.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読めない箇所を担当へ伝えます。ご自身で書ける欄は、ご確認できる範囲で進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the staff member which part you can't read. Continue with fields you can write yourself, within what you can verify.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 氏名と日付は自分で確認して書きます。注意書きは一行ずつ読んでいただき、意味も聞いてから返事をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見える本人日付を記入し注意書きは一行ずつ読み意味確認後返答したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check and write my name and the date myself. I'd like the notes read one line at a time, and ask their meaning before responding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will fill in the visible name and date, and want the notes read line by line and explained before answering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当がご説明します。ご家族へ電話して代わりに返事をしてもらうご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain. Would you like to phone family to answer on your behalf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、読む支援がほしいだけです。内容を理解して、選択や返事は自分でします。家族の判断をそのまま写すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族代理判断ではなく読支援を受け本人が理解選択すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I only want help reading. I'll understand the content and make choices and answers myself. I don't intend simply to copy my family's judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you want reading assistance, not family proxy decisions, and will understand and choose yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を伝えます。説明を聞く間はこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on your wishes. Please wait here while hearing the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見える欄を書いて待ちます。読めない行を示し、一つずつ説明を聞いて、自分の理解が合うか確かめてから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見える欄後待ち不明行を示し説明と理解確認後に記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll fill in the visible fields and wait. I'll point out the unreadable lines, hear each explanation, check my understanding, and then write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after filling visible fields you will wait, point out unclear lines, hear explanations, confirm understanding, then write.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 読む支援と、ご本人による確認の希望で承りました。担当へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted your wish for reading help and verification by you personally. I'll guide you to the staff member. Please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人を店へ案内していますが、以前あった看板を目印に曲がるつもりで来たら、看板がなくなっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昔の看板がなく道順に迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm guiding a friend to a shop. I came planning to turn at a sign that used to be there, but the sign has disappeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that an old landmark sign is gone and you are unsure of the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店の名前か住所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the shop's name or address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の案内にある住所を持っています。看板がなくなったことだけで、店も閉まったとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的地の住所を示し閉店と断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the address from the shop's information. I haven't decided the shop is closed just because the sign is gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination's address and say in Japanese that you are not concluding the shop has closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所を見せてください。今いる場所は、この地図の交差点です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the address. We are at this intersection on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。私は友人に「赤い看板を右」と伝えてしまいました。友人が先へ行く前に、古い目印だったと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ古い目印で案内したことを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I already told my friend “right at the red sign.” I'll tell them it was an old landmark before they go ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct in Japanese the directions you gave your friend using an old landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人は今どちらにいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この交差点の反対側です。二人で地図を見られるよう、渡れる所を確認して合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の位置を伝えて地図を一緒に見る方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Across this intersection. I'll check where we can cross and meet up so we can look at the map together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your friend's location and explain in Japanese how you will look at the map together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流してから住所と通りを見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: After meeting, compare the address with the street.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。地図では次の角です。赤い看板を探すのをやめ、通りの名前と住所で道順を説明し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の通りと住所で道順を説明し直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. On the map it's the next corner. I'll stop looking for the red sign and explain the route again using the street name and address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the route again in Japanese using the current street and address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分からなくなったら、現在地を確認してお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: If you become unsure, check your current location and ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。はがきの差出しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you sending a postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ、郵送せずに旅の記念として持ち帰りたいはがきです。記念になる印を押していただけるか、まず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵送せず持ち帰るはがきへの記念の押印を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, this is a postcard I want to take home as a travel souvenir without mailing. I'd like to ask first whether you can put a commemorative mark on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a commemorative stamp on a postcard you will take home without mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたかへ届くことをご希望ではないのですね。宛名は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you don't want it delivered to anyone. Is an addressee written on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛名は書いていません。自分の住所を書いて送るつもりもありません。郵便物として受け付けてもらう相談ではなく、持ち帰るための押印の相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名を書いておらず郵便物の差出しではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No addressee. I don't intend to write my own address and send it either. I'm not asking to submit it as mail, but to have it stamped to take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that no addressee is written and you aren't submitting it for mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望する日付や図柄などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a preferred date or design?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 旅を始めた昨日の日付があればと思いました。ただ、昨日の日付へ変えて押してほしいという意味ではありません。どの日付の印になるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望した昨日の日付について変更を求めず使用日付を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought it would be nice to have yesterday's date, when my trip began. But I don't mean I want you to change the date to yesterday and stamp it. I want to check what date the mark would have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which date would be used, without requesting a change to the desired date of yesterday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望は分かりました。押印できる種類や日付は、対応を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I understand. We'll explain which types and dates can be stamped after checking what we can offer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。切手の横に自分で描いた絵があります。そこに印が重なるかも確認したいので、押す前に位置を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の絵と印の位置が重なるか押印前に確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I drew a picture beside the postage stamp. I'd also like to check whether the mark would overlap it, so could you show me the position before stamping?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check whether the mark overlaps your drawing before it is applied.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応と位置を確認し、ご希望に合わなければ押さずにお返しする形でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: May we check availability and placement, and return it unstamped if it doesn't meet your wishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。絵に重なる場合は今回は押さずに持ち帰ります。押印できる場合も発送はせず、終わったはがきをこちらで受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 絵に重なるなら押さず返却し対応できても郵送しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If it overlaps the drawing, I'll take it home without a mark this time. Even if stamping is possible, don't mail it; I'll collect the finished postcard here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese that if it overlaps the picture you will take it back unstamped, and that even if possible it won't be mailed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まだ押印も郵送の受付もせず、ご希望に対応できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't stamp it or accept it for mailing yet; we'll first check whether we can meet your wishes.
